body.intent: Fix A run blocked on a permission prompt does not reach the inbox, and rhiza session message hangs on it. Run 01M6ZMRGYP9BQFAC0QNG2J9KHH (pre-publish audit), builder session 411ae041 (bypassPermissions) hit a plugin hook confirmation (cc-plugin-privacy: the command held the owner's email) at 2026-11-09T07:55:57Z; the run log shows 'step build/build: blocked on permission' and session show reports 'blocked permission', but rhiza inbox said 'Nothing waits on you' for 36+ min. After I answered the prompt (No, via rex send-key), 'rhiza session message 411ae041 <text>' hung >2 min although the session was idle at its prompt; typing via rex block send worked. Expect: a blocked-permission session is an inbox item naming the prompt and how to answer it; session message delivers to an idle session or times out with an error.
